name: Content-to-Market Frame Router
intent: Derive a source-faithful, human-recognizable product/market story before sending approved direction to CGM or a builder

status_model.accepted: Explicit editor/owner decision required; neither model confidence nor build checks grant acceptance
status_model.stale: Must re-review because upstream assumptions changed
status_model.rejected: Must preserve the failure reason and invalidate dependent artifacts

stages.question: What is being sold, to whom, and with which evidence/privacy boundaries?
stages.gate: Source/repo and public-private separation recorded; no assumptions promoted to facts

stages.question: What does this repo own, what does the integrated product do, and what is only specified?
stages.gate: Product identity and central promise substantiated to their claimed status; disputed capabilities block stronger copy

stages.question: Which person is trying to make what progress, and what repeatedly gets in their way?
stages.gate: A concrete human situation is stated without jargon, with external-user evidence distinguished from hypothesis

stages.question: Which of at least three plausible but different market positions best connects true capabilities to meaningful progress?
stages.gate: Owner explicitly selects or rejects a positioning angle; no single-module collapse or first-party ROI extrapolation

stages.question: In what order should buyer beliefs change and what should the visual story accomplish?
stages.gate: Human editor approves problem/promise/scene logic; no fabricated customer case; story advances instead of reporting process

stages.question: What exact creative constraints must CGM and any app builder implement?
stages.gate: Scenes/claims/assets link to accepted decisions; CGM owns writing/image/HTML implementation, not market-position selection

stages.question: Would a skeptical human recognize the correct value and would all displayed/interactive promises be true?
stages.gate: Truth and behavior must pass; editorial acceptance recorded separately from implementation/test success

parallelism.allowed: Independent product evidence and buyer/market research can occur concurrently after S0; merge under S1/S2 before S3
parallelism.forbidden: Website/image/video build before accepted S3+S4 decisions; concurrent writers mutating accepted source-of-truth records

side_track.when: The requested work includes changing product interaction, onboarding, navigation, task completion or recovery states
side_track.rule: Separate from marketing belief scenes; trace every interaction claim to observable system behavior; owner chooses when to activate

context_policy.default_source_mode: IDs plus canonical links, selective snippets; never full transcript/codebase dump
context_policy.reuse_rule: Carry forward accepted conclusions, supporting evidence links, rejected reasons and open questions; re-open source only when decision/evidence invalidates
context_policy.invalidations: A changed buyer, product scope, promise or CTA marks dependent scenes and media stale
context_policy.private_to_public: Summarize safely; never transfer private transcripts, credentials, internal filesystem paths or screenshots

approval_policy.assistant_may: investigate, hypothesize, propose, flag contradictions, create drafts
approval_policy.assistant_must_not: treat confidence as approval, fabricate customer outcomes, claim a preview is a real install, silently expand product scope

downstream: app builder only after creative lock
integration.ownership: This router owns pre-generation judgment/handoff and semantic critique, not CGM module implementations or release pinning
